title: Hanasato Minori — Watch Me Transform!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for joining us here today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: <Of course♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're happy to see the rest of you all here as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you for letting us join you for such a fun-sounding idea♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, we've all really been looking forward to this.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to do our best to meet your expectations. Take it away, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I've been thinking about doing a segment called “Walking with Minori” on our channel. It'll involve me going to all the places everyone wants me to visit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And guess what?! I'll be streaming it solo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You get to do your own stream?! That's so cool♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Yeah, it is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, Rin, don't get her too worked up. We haven't actually given it the green light yet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, really?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we need to make sure that I'm going to be able to handle things on my own and deal with emergencies okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's why we asked you guys to join us.
We need you to be the viewers for episode zero of “Walking with Minori.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, Airi and I will be playing that same role, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As the viewers, instead of posting comments, I'll need you all to tell me what you think directly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We need to see how she handles people's comments, so feel free to say some really outrageous stuff! Otherwise, this won't be a good test.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But I don't want to feel like we're bullying her...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <This is for Minori's sake, so let's steel our hearts as best we can!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And don't worry, Minori! We know you'll do great♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Today, I'll be kicking off a brand-new solo stream called “Walking with Minori!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As you can probably tell from the title, I'll be going on walks while carrying my phone around! Let's hear some applause♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Rin & Miku
rows.Line:
Go, Minori♪
<Go, Minori♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But before we go for our walk, I'd like to tell you guys about why I decided to start doing this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you're gonna explain?
I was just about to comment on that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To our delight, MORE MORE JUMP! has been receiving a mountain of offers for work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Most are for our group, but we've each been getting solo offers as well! It's been really great!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Getting to see you girls on TV more has made me so happy♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That episode of Arimura's show you were on was so good!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I want more and more people to learn about MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for all your kind words.
We plan on doing our best moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we also want to keep doing livestreams, since they mean a lot to us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I decided to try my hand at doing streams on my own! So that we can all stay connected!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's what “Walking with Minori” is gonna be about!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna do everything in my power to make sure we all have a good time together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, we can walk while we talk!
Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Those flowers are so pretty. Can you go a little closer?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sure, let's have a look...
They're beautiful, and so colorful♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can we see you with the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Me?
Gimme one second!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
They have rent-a-bikes over there!
It seems like a great time to go cycling!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What do they have at that shop over there?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You doing some food reviews could be fun.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh no! Everyone's talking all at once!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But that's when I need to stay calm...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Uhh... I know!
First, I'll show me with these flowers...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone, how's this...?
Can you see the flowers okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You look really cute♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori's so composed...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I can't say for sure, but I think she's giving herself time to think while posing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't jump on that cycling comment, Minori. You only have one hand free because of your phone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Nice work, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<That ended up being a nice walk♪
We got to see some flowers and visit that shop together.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you did a good job of pausing temporarily while you went to get permission to film inside.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was also nice of you to gently remind everyone that cycling wasn't an option because you needed one hand to hold your phone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that'll help your viewers come up with ideas that you can actually do on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, that was a really fun walk.
I hope the real thing is just as enjoyable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Wait, the real thing...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Walking with Minori” has been approved!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We'll be rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We believe in you, Minori♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I, Minori Hanasato, promise to do my absolute best!
